newsitem.title: USA: Bear Stearns files $5.0 bln shelf debt.
newsitem.headline: Bear Stearns files $5.0 bln shelf debt.

text.p: Bear Stearns Cos Inc filed Monday with the Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf registration for up to $5.0 billion in debt securities and warrants.
When combined with previous registrations, Bear Stearns said it will have up to $6.2 billion in debt securities and warrants available for sale.

Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including additions to working capital, repayment of short-term debt and investments to or extensions of credit to its subsidiaries, the Wall Street investment firm said.
